note: Sanity set for D-048 (16 questions). PDFs are not committed; download each source_url into this folder as <file>.

questions.question: What toughness did scaffolds reach with a 20% PLGA coating compared with uncoated ones?
questions.snippet: the toughness goes up further from 0.94 to 1.73 and 2.18 MPa

questions.question: How much did the coating change the compressive strength relative to the bare scaffold?
questions.snippet: The compressive strength of the coated sample was 4.19 MPa

questions.question: Which PLGA concentration gave the strongest scaffolds in compression?
questions.snippet: samples coated with 12.5% PLGA enjoy the highest compressive strength

questions.question: How much of each polymer coating had degraded after 32 weeks?
questions.snippet: After 32 weeks, 100 wt% of the GEL, 94 wt% of PLLA

questions.question: How quickly was the drug released from uncoated scaffolds?
questions.snippet: 94.7% of it is released during the first nine hours

questions.question: What is the glass transition temperature range of the PLGA copolymer?
How porous were scaffolds with hollow channels compared with solid scaffolds after sintering?
questions.snippet: significantly higher porosity of approximately 84% compared to the solid scaffold (73%)

questions.question: How much did the printed parts shrink vertically during sintering?
questions.snippet: while the shrinkage in the Z direction was 44.48

questions.question: Which outer strut shapes gave the highest bending strength?
questions.snippet: Out-t and Out-s have relatively high bending strengths

questions.question: What were the diameters of the coaxial nozzle outlet and its mandrel?
questions.snippet: round outlet (1.70 mm in diameter) and a round mandrel (0.65 mm in diameter)

questions.question: At what strain does the ceramic paste stop behaving like a solid and start to flow?
questions.snippet: underwent a transition at around 5% shear strain from solid-like to liquid-like behavior

questions.question: How does the spacing between printed rods set the porosity and pore size?
questions.snippet: rod spacing of 0.5 mm corresponds to a porosity of 55%

questions.question: Why must the printing speed stay within a limited range during robocasting?
questions.snippet: the paste will dry up in the printing nozzle, thus clogging it

questions.question: What formed on the hybrid scaffolds after three weeks in simulated body fluid?
questions.snippet: they developed an apatite layer on their surface

questions.question: Why is the polylactide used in the inks amorphous?
questions.snippet: the as received PLA is amorphous since it contains 14% of D isomer

questions.question: How high can the ceramic content of the inks be, and how does that compare with bone?
questions.snippet: very close to the mineral content of cortical bone
